# stalwart_sender_auth (Resource)

Configures sender authentication verification including DKIM, SPF, DMARC, and ARC. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `arc_verify` (Attributes) Whether ARC verification is strict, relaxed or disabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--arc_verify))
- `dkim_sign_domain` (Attributes) Domain to use for DKIM signing (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dkim_sign_domain))
- `dkim_strict` (Boolean) Whether to ignore insecure DKIM signatures such as those containing a length parameter
- `dkim_verify` (Attributes) Whether DKIM verification is strict, relaxed or disabled (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dkim_verify))
- `dmarc_verify` (Attributes) Whether DMARC verification is strict, relaxed or disabled (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dmarc_verify))
- `reverse_ip_verify` (Attributes) How strict to be when verifying the reverse DNS of the client IP (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reverse_ip_verify))
- `spf_ehlo_verify` (Attributes) Whether SPF EHLO verification is strict, relaxed or disabled (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spf_ehlo_verify))
- `spf_from_verify` (Attributes) Whether SPF MAIL FROM verification is strict, relaxed or disabled (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spf_from_verify))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
